# Custom WordPress Website Development

Custom WordPress websites with responsive, high-performance layouts, secure plugins and easy content management.

WordPress runs a large share of the web because it makes content easy to manage. DevEraXTech builds custom sites on it that keep that ease of editing while avoiding the slow, bloated feel of off-the-shelf themes.

We design custom layouts, keep plugins to a vetted minimum, harden security and tune performance so the site stays fast and safe as your content grows.

How It Works

## How we deliver it, step by step
- 01 **Discovery call.** We learn your goals, audience and must-haves, and agree on scope, timeline and budget.
- 02 **Design.** You see the structure and look first, and we refine it with you before any code is written.
- 03 **Build & test.** We develop on a private staging link, then test speed, security, SEO and every screen size.
- 04 **Launch & care.** We go live, hand over with training and stay on hand with an optional care plan.

Good to Know

## Frequently asked questions

**Is WordPress secure enough for a company website?**

Yes, when it is built and maintained properly. We use a small set of trusted plugins, harden logins and file permissions, and recommend a care plan for ongoing updates and backups.

**Will my new site be fast?**

Yes. We build lightweight custom themes, optimize images and set up caching so pages load quickly and pass Google's Core Web Vitals.

**Can you fix or redesign an existing WordPress site?**

Yes. We refresh existing sites, clean up plugins and speed problems, and can take over maintenance after a short review.
